name: kettlebell good morning
description: A hip hinge with a kettlebell held at the chest. It strengthens the hamstrings, glutes and lower back.
instructions: Hold a kettlebell by the horns against your chest.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and knees slightly bent.
Push your hips back and hinge forward with a flat back.
Lower until you feel a stretch in your hamstrings.
Squeeze your glutes to stand tall again.
